RF.K.1.stem: Demonstrate emerging understanding of the organization of print.

W.K.1.stem: With guidance and support, use drawing, dictating, or writing to compose writing for a variety of high-stakes and low-stakes purposes.

SL.5.4.stem: Clearly report on a familiar topic or text or present an opinion including related facts.

SL.5.5.stem: Select or create audio recordings and visual/tactile displays to enhance a presentation.

L.5.1.stem: Use language to achieve desired meaning when communicating.
subs: Notice that standardized English is only one dialect of many.
Notice the differences in language between familiar and unfamiliar contexts.
Notice the varieties of English (e.g., dialects, registers) used in stories, dramas, or poems.
Expand sentences for meaning, interest, and style.
Use frequently occurring root words (e.g., talk) and the words that result when word endings are added (e.g., talked, talking, talks).

L.5.3.stem: Demonstrate understanding of word relationship and use.
subs: Determine the literal meaning of words and phrases in context.
Demonstrate understanding of words that have similar meanings
Identify words that describe an increasing number of personal emotional states.

L.5.6.stem: Demonstrate understanding of conventions of standardized English.
subs: Spell untaught word phonetically, drawing on letter-sound relationships and common spelling patterns.

L.5.5.stem: Demonstrate standardized English grammar and usage when communicating.
subs: Use frequently occurring conjunctions: and, but, or, for, because.
Form and use the past tense of frequently occurring irregular verbs (e.g., went, sat, ate, told).
